### CVE-2018-16873
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2018-12-14 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-20 CWE-20
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

In Go before 1.10.6 and 1.11.x before 1.11.3, the "go get" command is vulnerable to remote code execution when executed with the -u flag and the import path of a malicious Go package, or a package that imports it directly or indirectly. Specifically, it is only vulnerable in GOPATH mode, but not in module mode (the distinction is documented at https://golang.org/cmd/go/#hdr-Module_aware_go_get). Using custom domains, it's possible to arrange things so that a Git repository is cloned to a folder named ".git" by using a vanity import path that ends with "/.git". If the Git repository root contains a "HEAD" file, a "config" file, an "objects" directory, a "refs" directory, with some work to ensure the proper ordering of operations, "go get -u" can be tricked into considering the parent directory as a repository root, and running Git commands on it. That will use the "config" file in the original Git repository root for its configuration, and if that config file contains malicious commands, they will execute on the system running "go get -u".

Affected:
- [UNKNOWN] / golang: affected 1.10.6; affected 1.11.3

### CVE-2018-25046 — Path traversal in code.cloudfoundry.org/archiver
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 9.1
- CWE: CWE 29: Path Traversal: "\..\filename"
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.1 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

Due to improper path sanitization, archives containing relative file paths can cause files to be written (or overwritten) outside of the target directory.

Affected:
- code.cloudfoundry.org/archiver / code.cloudfoundry.org/archiver/extractor: affected 0 <0.0.0-20180523222229-09b5706aa936 (semver)
